title: IAM Roles and Permissions for AWS

blocks.text: As part of the onboarding process, you need to deploy the DSPM templates that create roles and permissions in the AWS organization. These templates create multiple IAM roles with the required permissions to establish a trust relationship between DSPM, the orchestrator account, and target accounts. Each role has permissions for various services and actions such as resource discovery, CloudTrail log collection, etc.
DSPM creates the following IAM roles to access the AWS accounts:

blocks.item: Resource Discovery Role
Mandatory Permissions
The resource discovery role is required for DSPM to discover resources within the onboarded accounts and collect CloudTrail logs. The role has the following permissions:

table: To list the log delivery settings for a specific log group
To list all the resources that are associated with a specific AWS WAFv2 web ACL
To assume a role in AWS

blocks.item: Additional Permissions for AWS Bedrock Resources

If the AWS Bedrock resources are encrypted with KMS keys, DSPM fails to collect the metadata. To enable metadata collection, explicitly add the kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey permissions to the resource discovery role.
To add the permissions:
Sign in to the AWS Management Console and go to IAM.
In the left-side navigation, select Roles.
Search and select the resource discovery role created by DSPM.
On the Permissions tab, click DSPM-BASIC-CUSTOM-POLICY.
In the Policy editor, add the following permissions and click Next.
kms:GenerateDataKey
kms:Decrypt
See image.
Click Save changes.

blocks.item: The kms:PutKeyPolicy, kms:CreateKey, kms:TagResource, kms:EnableKeyRotation, and kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion permissions are scoped exclusively to KMS keys created and tagged by DSPM (z-dspm-resource: true). These permissions do not apply to customer-managed KMS keys.
Put Evidence Role
The Put Evidence role is required for DSPM to store evidence data snippets in the specified S3 bucket. The role has the following permissions:

table: To put objects into the S3 bucket
To set the Access Control List (ACL) for an object in the export S3 bucket
To retrieve the region where a specific Amazon S3 bucket is located
To delete objects in the S3 bucket
To encrypt plaintext using a KMS key
To reencrypt ciphertext that was encrypted using a KMS key
To generate a data key for evidence KMS key to encrypt data
To decrypt ciphertext that was encrypted using a KMS key

blocks.item: Get Evidence Role
